title: Quenched Spanish Jackfruit Salad
description: A yeasty, light, energizing vegan dish that captures the spirit of pulpo a la gallega with a tropical twist of rum.
instructions: Rinse the bamboo steamer rack and set over a pot of simmering water.
Place shredded jackfruit, smoked paprika, sea salt, black pepper, and olive oil in a large bowl and toss until coated.
Spread the seasoned jackfruit evenly on the steamer rack and steam for ten minutes until warmed through.
While the jackfruit steams, heat a small pan over medium heat, pour in rum, and let it reduce for one minute to create a deglaze fond.
Add soy sauce and lime juice to the rum reduction and stir until glossy.
Remove the steamer rack from the pot and transfer the cooked jackfruit to the bowl with the deglaze fond, mixing gently.
Fold in chopped cilantro, parsley, red onion, pickled jalapeño, and lime juice.
Let the salad sit at room temperature for five minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve the quenched salad warm or at room temperature, optionally garnished with extra cilantro.
